newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ATHLETICS-10 MLN RAND FOR S.AFRICAN DEVELOPMENT.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-10 MLN RAND FOR S.AFRICAN DEVELOPMENT.

text.p: Athletics South Africa (ASA) on Tuesday announced a talent-identification project which would plough 10 million rand into development over the next four years.

"This plan can tap into the potential we know exists in South Africa. By November of this year we will have in place a select squad of 20 athletes who will receive specialist training," ASA development manager Richard Stander told a news conference.
"This squad will be selected on affirmative action lines with a specific emphasis being placed on women and disadvantaged athletes."

ASA will be working in conjunction with the United Schools Sport Association, the National Sports Council a.d the National Olympic Committee. The money for the project has been raised through sponsorship donaions.
